options.description: ack configuration options (mapped to .ackrc directives). All are optional. Nested fields reflect documented options only.

options.ignore_dir.description: Directories to ignore during recursive search (e.g. 'data', 'vendor'). Each entry must be a simple directory name (no path separators).

options.ignore_file.description: File filters in the form 'FILTER:ARGS' (e.g. 'ext:log' or 'is:.DS_Store').

options.color.description: Enable colorized output (--color). Ignored if output is redirected unless ACK_PAGER_COLOR is set.

options.color_filename.description: Color specification for filenames (e.g., 'bold red on_yellow').

options.color_match.description: Color specification for matched text (e.g., 'bold green').

options.color_linenumber.description: Color specification for line numbers (e.g., 'bold yellow').

options.color_columnnumber.description: Color specification for column numbers (e.g., 'bold yellow').

options.context.description: Number of context lines (--context). Zero disables context override from other config.

options.max_count.description: Maximum matches per file (--max-count). Zero means no limit.

options.output.description: Custom output format (--output) with Perl special vars (e.g., '$f:$.:$_').

options.range_start.description: Line pattern marking the start of a search range (--range-start).

options.range_end.description: Line pattern marking the end of a search range (--range-end).

options.types.include.description: File types to include in search (e.g., 'perl', 'html').

options.types.add.description: List of type extensions to add, each with type, filter, and args.

options.types.add[].args.description: List of extensions to add (no leading dots).

options.types.set.description: List of new or redefined file types, each with type, filter, and args.

options.types.set[].args.description: List of extensions to set (no leading dots).

options.types.delete.description: File types to remove from ack's type registry (e.g., 'backup').

options.passthru.description: Print all lines but highlight matches (--passthru).
